name: Retrieval Evaluation Harness
purpose: SELECTION-POLICY + NAMESPACE-PREDICATE OWNER + eval harness. Authors the ONE versioned DETERMINISTIC selection-policy library `selpol_rrf_v1` (lib/selpol_rrf_v1.py; CONTEXT_PACKET_CONTRACT s4 / P1-1, D-0087; PINNED D-0089) -- OWNED here, CONSUMED by the context compiler #40 AND by this harness's own A/B, so there is exactly ONE selection owner (removing the two-reranker problem). i33 (D-0096) folds MEMORY_CONTRACT A5 + the CONTEXT_PACKET_CONTRACT i33 amendment into selpol_rrf_v1 1.1.0->1.2.0 (ADDITIVE, 1.1.0-default byte-identical): (U1') NAMESPACE CLOSURE -- the ONE canonical predicate + rejection policy live in lib/namespace_policy.py (`ns_permitted` closed-set membership + `effective_allowed_namespaces` intersection(request,grant) + `NamespaceRejectionPolicy`), authored here + IMPORTED by #40 + mirrored by #36 (A5 risk-6, never re-implemented); a cross-namespace candidate is DROPPED before scoring and leaves NO identifying metadata in ANY output array (the ONLY caller-visible surface is `namespace_violation_count`/`namespace_closure_violated`; identifying detail -> a privileged security log). (U4') candidate-INDEPENDENT supersession -- the temporal stage consumes a per-candidate catalog `effective_current` boolean, so a superseded record is HARD-filtered under current_only EVEN when its successor is absent from the pool; the demote-ordering uses the catalog successor ref; a branch (two live successors) -> `supersession_conflicts`/`conflicted`. (U5') query_class (semantic) vs temporal_intent (temporal) are INDEPENDENT -- the versioned lib/classifier_policy.py maps class->intent (with `composite`+`unclassified` fallbacks) and an explicit user temporal_intent/version OUTRANKS the class default. i32 semantics retained: `hard_filter_namespace`/`hard_filter_stale`/`superseded_demote` reason codes, `contradicts` propagation (surfaced, not detected), OPEN channels (an explicit `retrieval_occurrences[]` fuses a novel channel with NO code change). eval 0.4->0.5 extends the `selection_conformance` block to MEASURE the leakage paths (namespace CLOSURE drop+sanitize, pool-independent current_only, supersession-chain+branch, the class/intent split) + reason-code coverage (integer-only, byte-identical on re-run). select(candidates, descriptor, policy_id, params) -> {selected[], ranked[], policy_id, policy_version, features_by_candidate, omission_manifest[], contradicts_pairs[], supersession_conflicts[], conflicted, temporal_intent, classifier_policy_id/version, namespace_policy_id/version, namespace_violation_count}; PURE + deterministic (no model/IO/state); stages: hard filters -> temporal stale-demote (s5) -> authority (epistemic_authority) -> versioned RRF over CHANNEL RANKS (retrieval_occurrences[], not cross-query raw scores; P1-2) -> occurrence-preserving DISPLAY dedup (identical text -> one display item + occurrences[] + evidence_cluster_id, provenance NEVER erased; P1-3) -> budget. Output is ADDITIVE: preserves retrieval_rank/lexical_rank/vector_rank/fused_rank and adds selection_rank/selection_score/selection_policy_id/selected/reason_codes -- it never re-sorts the retrieval array in place. The shipped standalone rerank() is now a THIN WRAPPER over this library (the measured A/B measures the library; the shipped 0.2 benchmark + A/B stay regression-green byte-for-byte at the metric-value level). eval-0.3 also scores PER STAGE (raw retrieval / post-filter / packet) + packet_disposition correctness (answerable|needs_expansion|abstain|conflicted|provenance_failed -- read from a supplied #40 packet or computed deterministically), and marks hybrid metrics not_applicable (NOT zero) while the vector channel is EMPTY (P1-4; full graded-relevance P1-4 is a named follow-on). Make retrieval + packet quality MEASURABLE against the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT s6 evaluation gates (D-0083; eval-0.2/0.3, i29/i30). Runs a benchmark (schema lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2; the 0.1 schema is still accepted for regression) against ANY retriever satisfying the MEMORY_CONTRACT s3 retriever-0.2 interface (op search; inputs {query,k,filters?}; result = a ranked hit array in deterministic order; hit = span OBJECT {start,end}+span_label, record_id/record_version_id/record_kind, content_hash [SOURCE VERSION identity], status/currentness+authority_level, and per-channel diagnostics: retrieval_channels, lexical_rank+lexical_score, vector_rank+vector_similarity [null until vectors], fused_rank+fused_score, fusion_algo+fusion_version, embedding_space_id, index_snapshot/corpus_version, filter_decisions, tie_break_key). The retriever-0.1 hit shape (span string + opaque score) is still accepted (compat/migration). Ships its OWN deterministic LEXICAL BASELINE (BM25-lite over a fully-known fixture corpus, emitting retriever-0.2 hits, score_unit millionths) AND an external_command adapter (the seam the orchestrator points at the real artifact.search #36 at fold). eval-0.2 LABELS: must_include_all/must_include_any evidence groups, required version/span, acceptable-equivalent spans, explicitly-stale versions, forbidden_sources, hard privacy exclusions, distractors, no_answer_expected, label rationale/status/reviewer, corpus snapshot -- a FILE-level hit is NOT credit (chunk/span level matching). TEMPORAL INTENT per query (current_only|historical_as_of|version_specific|any_valid_version; 'a stale required source is always a miss' holds ONLY for current_only). METRICS: recall@K, MRR (kept) + precision@K, nDCG@K, evidence-group coverage, forbidden/privacy/stale-hit rate, duplicate/near-dup burden, source diversity, provenance VALIDITY (not presence), snippet-span correctness, relevant-token ratio, no-answer false-positive rate, hybrid uplift/regression. PROVENANCE VALIDATION: content_hash identifies the expected source version; the source exists or is tombstoned; the span is in bounds; reading the span reproduces the cited text; the snippet derives from it; the parser+chunker fingerprint is known; current/stale status is correct. HYBRID ATTRIBUTION from the retriever-0.2 per-channel diagnostics (lexical-only/vector-only/hybrid); the vector channel runs EMPTY today and is reported cleanly. A DETERMINISTIC RERANKER (directive 8.3 / skill-activation Stage 4; NO model) takes the retriever-0.2 hit array + a task/query descriptor and returns the SAME hit-array shape reordered by deterministic features (direct relevance, authority, freshness/currentness, project/component match, task-stage match, failure likelihood, procedural applicability) + DIVERSITY; the harness MEASURES it (rerank uplift/regression vs the raw order + per-query rescue/demote). Emits TWO deterministic reports -- report.json (machine, schema lifeorch.retrieval_eval_report/0.5) and report.md (human) -- both canonical (UTF-8 no BOM, sorted keys, integer-only: scores millionths, ratios ppm; no timestamps/invocation-ids/absolute-paths/latency), byte-identical on a re-run across machines (query latency/resource live in the volatile worker-summary.json, never the report). content_hash is EOL-normalized so a CRLF vs LF checkout hashes identically. Thin pwsh wrapper over a stdlib-only Python worker (retrieval_eval.py). CPU-only, no model, no CUDA, no network -> parallel_safe:true. i34 (0.6.0, D-0098) ADDS the Tier-1 HIERARCHY eval (op hierarchy-eval, the SEPARATE self-contained worker hierarchy_eval.py; the benchmark path + retrieval_eval.py are UNCHANGED): MEASURES the bounded-fanout hierarchy #36/#40 build, defending the frontier red-team's concern (pack b4c90545) that bounded deterministic navigation is NOT automatically recall-preserving. Deterministic synthetic model (adversarial scale + mutation fixtures) with the external_command adapter as the fold seam for the REAL #36 shortlist/descend + #40 packet. Measures: NAVIGATION-COST (nodes examined vs leaf count across >=2 orders of magnitude -> sub-linear O(B*log_F N), p50/p95, NOT constant); DUAL recall (hierarchy-PATH recall reached-vs the fast beam AND end-to-end PACKET-EVIDENCE recall retained -- the safe-pruning + fallback contract [a branch is excluded ONLY when a SOUND no-false-negative predicate proves absence; else expand/fallback/needs_expansion; a STALE synopsis never prunes] preserves packet recall exactly where a naive beam silently misses); shortlist REGRET; fallback FREQUENCY; STALE-WINDOW recall; the Tier-1 GATE SET (structural/security/mutation-freshness/retrieval/complexity) as deterministic checks; and the ~200MB real-corpus REHEARSAL scaffolded + FLAGGED as the OPEN pre-freeze gate (synthetic scale is necessary, NOT sufficient -> Tier-1 acceptance is NOT claimed on synthetic-only). Emits hierarchy_report.json (lifeorch.hierarchy_eval_report/0.1, integer-only ppm, byte-identical on re-run) + hierarchy_report.md. i35 (0.7.0, plan fo-35-0a5bf334, D-0090/D-0098/D-0077) turns the i34 rehearsal SCAFFOLD into a RUNNABLE Tier-1 ACCEPTANCE-GATE harness (op rehearsal, the SEPARATE self-contained worker rehearsal_eval.py; the benchmark + hierarchy-eval paths are UNCHANGED + byte-identical): it INGESTS a REAL FOREIGN corpus slice (a committed click 8.1.7 permissive-BSD sample + a hash-verified full-corpus fetch recipe in FULL_CORPUS_RECIPE.md) into a #36 hierarchy via #36's shipped ingest/ingest-records/build-hierarchy ops, runs a MANUALLY-LABELED query set (cross-cutting / rare-decisive-term / current-vs-historical / exact-reference / global-synthesis, with PINNED outcomes), and MEASURES the MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE s10 Tier-1 criteria against #36/#40 driven READ-ONLY through the external_command adapter seam: (a) BOUNDED context cost across >=2 orders of magnitude of leaf count; (b) cross-namespace CONTAMINATION below threshold (0); (c) CURRENT-vs-HISTORICAL correctness (current_only excludes the superseded record, historical retrieves it); (d) every excerpt RECONSTRUCTS to source (content_hash==file sha256; span reproduces bytes); (e) NAVIGATION cost SUB-LINEAR in leaf count (p50/p95, via #36 shortlist/descend since the #40 CLI is FLAT-only today); plus DUAL recall (fast beam vs exhaustive-flat/guaranteed vs packet-evidence), shortlist REGRET, fallback FREQUENCY. CLI-AGNOSTIC: it measures WHATEVER #36/#40 CLIs it is pointed at (default: the real cores relative to the module; the orchestrator overrides argv to Lane A's WIRED #40 CLI at fold). It emits a canonical rehearsal_report.json (lifeorch.rehearsal_eval_report/0.1, integer-only ppm, byte-identical on the deterministic sample path) + rehearsal_report.md + a single computed tier1_accepted -- it does NOT claim project-level Tier-1 acceptance (the orchestrator runs the full ~200MB gate at fold and owns the project flip); if a #36/#40 output field a criterion needs is ABSENT it records a fold_reconciliation flag and REFUSES tier1_accepted (never a silent pass). i36 (0.8.0, plan fo-36-1a676e4b, D-0100) ADDS the opt-in WIRED-DESCEND drive path (request wired_descend:true, or config.wired_descend; a caller NOT requesting it gets the 0.7.0 flat metrics BYTE-IDENTICAL, regression-proven): it DRIVES #40 0.7.0's SHIPPED public -Retriever artifact_search shortlist-and-descend port (aa2f0fb) end-to-end -- constructs SCOPED DESCEND-class (global_synthesis|precedent_search) artifact_search compile requests over the built #36 catalog (retriever=artifact_search + catalog_db_path + a single-namespace effective grant + the pinned corpus_version), invoked via the overridable adapter m40_argv, and MEASURES s10 against the WIRED packets: bounded context cost + 0 cross-namespace contamination + current-vs-historical + reconstruct-to-source + NAVIGATION SUB-LINEAR from #40's OWN plan trace (packet.retrieval_completeness.navigation_nodes_examined, NOT #36-direct counts) + DUAL recall (hierarchy-PATH reach [the bounded descend fast-beam -- PARTIAL, the honest red-team gap] AND end-to-end PACKET-EVIDENCE recall [the exhaustive #36-flat fallback preserves it -- FULL]) + shortlist REGRET + fallback FREQUENCY + STALE-WINDOW recall (a stale synopsis never prunes -> recall preserved, never a silent miss). The #36-direct-nav + #40-flat path is RETAINED as a LABELED baseline (descend-vs-flat deltas). If #40 0.7.0 cannot be driven into descend, the harness records a fold_reconciliation + REFUSES tier1_accepted. tier1_accepted stays HARNESS-COMPUTED over the corpus+CLI it is pointed at (the orchestrator runs the full ~200MB gate vs the frozen #40 0.7.0 WIRED CLI at fold + owns the project flip). i40 (0.8.1, PB-5/D-0108, plan fo-40-d42fd1ac) RECONCILES the version surfaces + the wired digest, NO behavior change: THIS manifest's `version` is the ONE declared module-release version -- the wrapper envelope now DERIVES skill_version/contract_version from skill.json at invocation (the stale hardcoded 0.7.0 literals are REMOVED) and the test harness permanently asserts envelope==manifest on every parsed envelope (cloud + -Live; future drift fails loudly); measurement identities (rehearsal GENERATOR_VERSION 0.8.0, report schema ids, policy versions) version INDEPENDENTLY by measurement semantics (SCHEMA_NOTES s18). tests/test_rehearsal_eval.py WIRED_STRUCTURAL_DIGEST re-pinned to the i39-fold-verified sha256:d0d54aba... (the #36 0.7.0 fast-beam legitimately moved the wired structure; 11/11 s10 criteria, hierarchy_path_recall 117647 ppm, guaranteed+packet 1,000,000 ppm INTACT; flat pins + the non-wired path byte-identical).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -InputFile <benchmark.json> (a lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2 or /0.1 file) OR -InputsJson '<json {benchmark|input: path-or-inline-object, corpus_dir?, provenance_corpus_dir?, retriever?, k_values?, retrieval_depth?, base_dir?, python_path?, worker_path?}>'. Also: -CorpusDir, -RetrieverJson '<spec json>', -KValues <int[]>, -RetrievalDepth <int>, -BaseDir <dir>, -PythonPath, -WorkerPath, -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId. Precedence: -InputFile > InputsJson.benchmark > InputsJson.input. i34 (0.6.0, D-0098): -Op hierarchy-eval (or -InputsJson '{op:hierarchy-eval, scales?, seed?, fanout?, beam?}') runs the Tier-1 HIERARCHY eval (a SEPARATE self-contained worker hierarchy_eval.py) -> hierarchy_report.json (lifeorch.hierarchy_eval_report/0.1) + hierarchy_report.md; the default benchmark op is UNCHANGED + byte-identical. i35 (0.7.0, plan fo-35-0a5bf334): -Op rehearsal (or -InputsJson '{op:rehearsal, benchmark?, corpus_root?, adapter?, scales?, fanout?, config?}') runs the Tier-1 ACCEPTANCE-GATE REHEARSAL (a SEPARATE self-contained worker rehearsal_eval.py driving the REAL #36/#40 CLIs over a committed real foreign corpus) -> rehearsal_report.json (lifeorch.rehearsal_eval_report/0.1) + rehearsal_report.md + a computed tier1_accepted; the default benchmark + hierarchy-eval paths are UNCHANGED + byte-identical. i36 (0.8.0, plan fo-36-1a676e4b): -Op rehearsal now also accepts wired_descend (bool, or config.wired_descend) -> the harness ALSO DRIVES #40 0.7.0's WIRED descend path + flips the AUTHORITATIVE tier1_accepted (and adds measurement_mode + wired_tier1_* to the summary) to the WIRED result; a non-wired request stays byte-identical to 0.7.0.

inputs.name: benchmark
inputs.description: The benchmark: a JSON file path (via -InputFile) or an inline lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2 object (via -InputsJson.benchmark). {benchmark_id, corpus_dir?, provenance_corpus_dir?, retriever?, k_values?, retrieval_depth?, tombstones?, queries:[{query_id, query, temporal_intent?, required_sources:[{source_path, content_hash?, span?:{start,end}|string, span_label?, require_span?, chunk_id?, acceptable_spans?, must_reproduce_text?}], evidence_groups?:[{group_id, mode:all|any, members:[...]}], stale_sources?, forbidden_sources?, privacy_exclusions?, distractors?, no_answer_expected?, rerank_descriptor?:{namespace?, component?, task_stage?, seeking_failures?}, label_rationale?, label_status?, reviewer?, corpus_snapshot?, filters?}]}. The lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.1 schema (required_sources/stale_sources/forbidden_sources only, span as a string) is still accepted (temporal_intent defaults to current_only).

inputs.name: corpus_dir
inputs.description: Override the lexical-baseline corpus directory (else benchmark.retriever.corpus_dir / benchmark.corpus_dir); resolved relative to base_dir. Also used as the provenance-validation corpus when provenance_corpus_dir is absent.

inputs.name: provenance_corpus_dir
inputs.description: The source-of-truth corpus that hits are VALIDATED against (s6 provenance validation). Defaults to corpus_dir / benchmark.corpus_dir / the lexical baseline's corpus. When absent entirely, provenance validity degrades to presence + format checks (reported as provenance_validated=false).

inputs.name: retriever
inputs.description: Override the retriever spec. kind=lexical_baseline {corpus_dir, k1?, b?, include_suffixes?, exclude_dir_names?} OR kind=external_command {argv:[...], request_via:stdin|file|arg, hits_pointer?='result.hits', timeout_seconds?} (the fold seam -> the real #36 artifact.search retriever-0.2). argv tokens {PYTHON}/{BASE_DIR}/{MODULE_ROOT}/{REQUEST_FILE}/{REQUEST_JSON} are substituted at call time. Hits are normalized (retriever-0.2 shape preferred; retriever-0.1 accepted).

inputs.name: k_values
inputs.description: The K set for recall@K / precision@K / nDCG@K / source-diversity@K (ints).

inputs.name: retrieval_depth
inputs.description: Max hits requested from the retriever per query (raised to at least max(k_values)).

inputs.name: base_dir
inputs.description: Directory used to resolve a relative corpus_dir / provenance_corpus_dir and external-retriever argv paths (default = the benchmark file's directory).

outputs.description: { benchmark_id, benchmark_schema, retriever_kind, num_queries, k_values, retrieval_depth, ratio_unit='ppm', provenance_validated, vector_channel_status, selection_policy{policy_id,policy_version,rrf_k,stages,namespace_policy_id/version,classifier_policy_id/version}, packet_disposition{scored,num_labeled,num_correct,accuracy_ppm}, selection_conformance{namespace_isolation_violations,namespace_closure_violations,cross_namespace_in_ranked_total,namespace_violations_total,current_only_stale_leaks,pool_independent_current_only_leaks,supersession_order_violations,supersession_pairs_total,queries_with_supersession_branch,queries_with_contradicts,queries_conflicted,reason_code_coverage_count} (i33/D-0096 eval-0.5), aggregate{raw retriever order: recall_at_k_ppm, recall_at_k_micro_ppm, precision_at_k_ppm, ndcg_at_k_ppm, source_diversity_at_k_ppm, mrr_ppm, evidence_group_coverage_ppm, stale_source_rate_ppm, stale_hit_rate_ppm, forbidden_hit_rate_ppm, privacy_hit_rate_ppm, judged_irrelevant_rate_ppm, duplicate_burden_ppm, relevant_token_ratio_ppm, provenance_completeness_ppm, provenance_validity_ppm, snippet_span_correctness_ppm, no_answer_false_positive_rate_ppm, queries_all_required_present, ...}, aggregate_reranked{same, on the reranked/post-filter order}, aggregate_packet{same, on the packet-stage selection}, stage_metrics{raw,post_filter,packet}, rerank_ab{queries_with_rescue, queries_with_demote, deltas{ndcg/precision/recall/evidence-group/forbidden/stale}}, report_json{path,sha256,bytes}, report_md{path,sha256,bytes}, input_digest }. Artifacts: report.json (lifeorch.retrieval_eval_report/0.5 -- canonical, deterministic, machine-readable: selection_policy + selection_conformance (i33/D-0096) + hybrid_applicability + aggregate_raw + aggregate_reranked + aggregate_packet + stage_metrics + rerank_ab + rerank_diagnostics + hybrid_attribution + packet_disposition_eval + per_query_raw + per_query_reranked + per_query_packet + per_query_selection_conformance, each per-query carrying matched@K/recall@K/precision@K/nDCG@K/evidence groups/stale+wrong-version hits/forbidden+privacy+distractor hits/no-answer FP/returned-with-provenance-validity + the ADDITIVE selection fields retrieval_rank/selection_rank/selection_score/selection_policy_id/selected/reason_codes/evidence_cluster_id/occurrence_count), report.md (human), worker-summary.json (carries the VOLATILE query latency/resource). On failure the envelope is status=error with a structured error and no reports.
